settings.heading: Dolls that are born by hand
settings.text: Every Buni, Tenta or Wooly is crocheted by a passionate maker. A unique, soft companion, made to last a lifetime.

settings.title: Cut
settings.text: Each body is cut from unbleached cotton using paper patterns we drew ourselves.

settings.title: Sew
settings.text: Every seam is stitched twice, so arms and legs survive years of being carried by one hand.

settings.title: Stuff
settings.text: We fill each doll with carded wool, firm in the neck and soft in the tummy.

settings.title: Embroider
settings.text: Faces are embroidered by hand, which is why no two expressions match.

settings.title: Dress
settings.text: Clothes come off and go back on with snaps that small hands can manage.

settings.heading: How a doll is made
settings.text: One doll takes about a week from first cut to last stitch.

settings.heading: Every stitch, a love story.
settings.text: Isabelle crochets each doll by hand, in her studio in Lyon. Her first name goes with every creation, so you always know who made your child’s companion.

settings.title: Made in France
settings.text: By passionate makers, in their studios

settings.heading: A doll is not just a toy.
settings.text:
It is the first friend. The one that stays in the bed through feverish nights, travels in every suitcase, and may still be there in thirty years at the back of a drawer.

At Kwaii, every doll is crocheted by hand, stitch after stitch, by a maker who knows its name before it reaches you.

settings.heading: Give it a name.
settings.text: Have your child’s name embroidered on their doll, by hand, in gold thread. A birth present remembered for a lifetime, delivered in a gift box with its adoption certificate.
settings.caption: Buni, name embroidery, gold thread

settings.quote: My four-month-old daughter won’t let go of Tenta. The quality is incredible. You can really feel it was made by hand, with love.
settings.author: Céline M.

settings.quote: The adoption certificate melted us. An unforgettable birth present for my niece. Thank you, Kwaii.
settings.author: Thomas R.

settings.quote: I was looking for something original, not factory-made. Buni is perfect. You can see every stitch. This is real craft.
settings.author: Sophie L.

settings.heading: Join the Kwaii family
settings.text: Behind the scenes at the studio, new dolls, and advice on choosing a first doll. One gentle, honest letter a month.
